sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州及全球各地合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这完全符合该校旨在提升所有生命生活质量的使命。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%无形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: In the middle of Sproul Plaza on the campus of UC Berkeley is a sculpture 60,000 feet tall.
sentences.zh: 在加州大学伯克利分校校园的斯普罗尔广场中央，有一座高达六万英尺的雕塑。

sentences.en: But don't feel bad if you've never noticed it before.
sentences.zh: 不过，如果你以前从未注意到它，也不必感到难过。

sentences.en: I've had people, you know, come and look for it specifically and not find it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，曾有人专门跑来找它，结果却没找到。

sentences.en: That makes me think, well, maybe I should have made it a little bigger.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得，嗯，也许我应该把它做得再稍微大一点。

sentences.en: Or maybe that's just the cost of making an invisible sculpture.
sentences.zh: 或者，也许这就是创作一件隐形雕塑所付出的代价吧。

sentences.en: I'm kind of setting myself up, aren't I?
sentences.zh: 我这算是自己给自己挖坑，对吧？

sentences.en: That's Mark Bresvin Kempen.
sentences.zh: 那是马克·布雷斯万·肯彭。

sentences.en: His invisible sculpture is known to most as the Free Speech Monument.
sentences.zh: 他的这件隐形雕塑，大多数人称之为“言论自由纪念碑”。

sentences.en: It's actually, it's called Column of Earth and Air.
sentences.zh: 实际上，它的名字叫《土地与空气之柱》。

sentences.en: It's a six-inch circle of soil and the column of air above it,
sentences.zh: 它是一个直径六英寸的圆形土壤，以及它上方的空气柱，

sentences.en: extending all the way to the limit of U.S.-controlled airspace, hence the 60,000 feet.
sentences.zh: 一直延伸到美国控制领空的最外缘，因此高度达到了六万英尺。

sentences.en: The column is marked by a six-foot granite ring embedded flush into the concrete of the plaza.
sentences.zh: 这根柱子由一个嵌入广场混凝土中、与其平齐的六英尺花岗岩环标示出来。

sentences.en: The inscription of the outer edge reads,
sentences.zh: 外边缘的铭文写着：

sentences.en: This soil and the airspace extending above it shall not be part of any nation
sentences.zh: 这片土地及其上方延伸的空气不属于任何国家，

sentences.en: and shall not be subject to any entity's jurisdiction.
sentences.zh: 亦不受任何实体的管辖。

sentences.en: It's a sculpture that eschews the traditional materials of wood, clay, or metal and instead uses...
sentences.zh: 这是一座摒弃了木材、黏土或金属等传统材料的雕塑，它转而使用……

sentences.en: Jurisdiction laws and politics as kind of material to work with.
sentences.zh: 管辖权法律和政治作为一种创作材料。

sentences.en: The Free Speech Monument has both subtlety and grandeur,
sentences.zh: “言论自由纪念碑”既微妙宏大，

sentences.en: and it's also just fun and thought-provoking, a new way to consider jurisdictional space.
sentences.zh: 同时又充满趣味且引人深思，为思考管辖空间提供了一种全新方式。

sentences.en: Usually, spaces of jurisdiction you enter into.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，管辖空间是需要你走进去的。

sentences.en: You cross into a country, you cross into a state, you move into somebody's private property.
sentences.zh: 你进入一个国家，进入一个州，或者走进某人的私有财产。

sentences.en: And I thought it would be interesting to kind of invert that
sentences.zh: 而我觉得，把这一点反过来会很有意思，

sentences.en: and have a space that sort of moves through your body.
sentences.zh: 创造一个仿佛会穿过你身体的空间。

sentences.en: And when you stand next to it today, 20 years after it was installed,
sentences.zh: 如今，当你在它立好二十年后的今天站在它旁边时，

sentences.en: you'd never suspect the drama that went on to get this granite circle
sentences.zh: 你绝不会想到，为了把这个花岗岩圆环安置在大学土地上，曾经历过怎样的波折。

sentences.en: placed in the ground on university property.
sentences.zh: 我当时可以说是掉进了一个毫无准备的马蜂窝里。

sentences.en: I was kind of thrown into a little bit of a hornet's nest that I wasn't prepared for at all.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: Here's what happened.
sentences.zh: “言论自由纪念碑”诞生于一项公开的设计竞赛，

sentences.en: The Free Speech Monument was born out of an open design competition
sentences.zh: 旨在纪念“言论自由运动”发起二十五周年。

sentences.en: to commemorate the 25th anniversary of the start of the Free Speech Movement.
sentences.zh: 一群教授、前教授……

sentences.en: A bunch of professors, ex-professors...
sentences.zh: 他们自称为“伯克利艺术项目”。

sentences.en: They called themselves the Berkeley Art Project.
sentences.zh: ……独立于大学之外举办了这场竞赛。

sentences.en: ...put this competition together, separate from the university.
sentences.zh: 他们作为一个自治团体来完成这件事。

sentences.en: They did it as an autonomous group.
sentences.zh: 因为他们知道，如果试图通过大学来纪念言论自由运动，

sentences.en: Because they knew if they tried to go through the university
sentences.zh: 根本行不通。

sentences.en: to commemorate the Free Speech Movement, it would go nowhere.
sentences.zh: 因为在当时，大学根本不想以任何形式、任何方式去纪念言论自由运动。

sentences.en: Because at the time, the university did not want to commemorate the Free Speech Movement
sentences.zh: “言论自由运动”始于1964年秋天，

sentences.en: in any way, shape, or form.
sentences.zh: 当时学生们在斯普罗尔广场摆了个桌子，为一个校外民权组织招募成员。

sentences.en: The Free Speech Movement started in the fall of 1964
sentences.zh: 这在当时违反了学校的政策。

sentences.en: when students set up a table in Sproul Plaza to recruit for an off-campus civil rights group.
sentences.zh: 随后一切迅速升级。

sentences.en: This was against school policy at the time.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几个月里，静坐、罢工和逮捕事件接连不断。

sentences.en: And everything escalated from there.
sentences.zh: 这是一个至关重要的时刻，它定义了我们如今所理解的60年代。

sentences.en: The following months were marked by sit-ins and strikes and arrests.
sentences.zh: 因此，建立一座纪念碑似乎再合适不过了。

sentences.en: It was a pivotal moment that defined what we think of as the 60s.
sentences.zh: 总之，时间来到了1989年。

sentences.en: So a monument seems appropriate.
sentences.zh: 征集令发出了。

sentences.en: So anyway, it's 1989.
sentences.zh: 收到了数百个设计方案。

sentences.en: The call went out.
sentences.zh: 来自全国各地的参赛作品近三百件。

sentences.en: Hundreds of designs were considered.
sentences.zh: 他们从中筛选出了五个。

sentences.en: Close to 300 entries from all over the country.
sentences.zh: 随后进入了一个公开讨论和投票的阶段，

sentences.en: They weeded that down to five.
sentences.zh: 参与者包括公众、艺术评论家以及伯克利艺术项目以外的各种人群，

sentences.en: And there was this open period of public discussion and voting
sentences.zh: 最终选定马克·布雷斯万·肯彭的《土地与空气之柱》作为“言论自由纪念碑”。

sentences.en: that included the public and art critics and all kinds of people
sentences.zh: 不过，民主在艺术上并不总是那么管用。

sentences.en: outside of the Berkeley Art Project
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴这次成功了。

sentences.en: that eventually selected Mark Brest van Kempen's Column of Earth and Air
sentences.zh: 发起这个项目的人们

sentences.en: as the Free Speech Monument.
sentences.zh: 想把这件获奖作品作为礼物赠予大学。

sentences.en: Democracy doesn't always work with art, though.
sentences.zh: 然后，不出所料，大学根本不想接受这份礼物。

sentences.en: So I'm glad that it worked out this time.
sentences.zh: 并竭尽所能地拒绝它。

sentences.en: The people who had put the project together
sentences.zh: 他们之所以如此抗拒，是因为伯克利艺术项目群体的许多人——

sentences.en: wanted to give the winning entry to the university as a gift.
sentences.zh: 也就是委托建造这座纪念碑的人，

sentences.en: And then, of course, the university did not want to accept it as a gift.
sentences.zh: 和大学的高层领导，

sentences.en: And did everything that they could not to.
sentences.zh: 正是二十五年前那场斗争中的同一拨人。

sentences.en: And the reason for the reluctance is that a lot of the Berkeley Art Project group,

sentences.en: the ones commissioning the monument,

sentences.en: and the higher-ups at the university
sentences.zh: 因此，加州大学伯克利分校既不想纪念整个言论自由运动，

sentences.en: were the same people who were in the fight 25 years before.
sentences.zh: 尤其还对这件作品恨之入骨。

sentences.en: And they were still very upset about it.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以……

sentences.en: They still had very hurt feelings.
sentences.zh: 他们动用了一切权力来拒绝接受这份礼物。

sentences.en: So UC Berkeley did not want to memorialize the free speech movement in general.
sentences.zh: 要想做到这一点却又同时保持好人形象，其实挺难的。

sentences.en: And they hated this piece in particular.

sentences.en: Yeah, so...

sentences.en: They did everything in their power to not accept this gift.
sentences.zh: 于是，大学决定在附加一个条件的前提下接受这座雕塑。

sentences.en: Which is kind of hard to do and still seem like a good guy.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，我们可以接受这个对言论自由的纪念，

sentences.en: And after this big public selection process,
sentences.zh: 但前提是发布的新闻稿中

sentences.en: they didn't have too much of a choice.

sentences.en: So the university decided to accept the sculpture under one condition.

sentences.zh: 几位早期言论自由运动的领袖
